_help.result: W, L, OTW, OTL, SOW or SOL, from Näädät's point of view
_help.us_side: home or away: which of the two teams is Näädät
_help.logo_file: path to the opponent logo (PNG/JPG), relative to where you run render_card.py; omit for a lettered badge
_help.periods: optional; delete the list contents if unknown
_help.goals: optional goal log for slide 2: {period, time 'mm:ss' elapsed game time, team 'us'|'them', scorer {full, short, last, first}, assists [same shape], type '', 'PP', 'SH' or 'EN', score_after 'home-away'}
_help.scorers_us: Näädät scorers; goals > 0 shows them on slide 1. Leave empty if unknown
_help.goalies: optional [{name {full, short, last, first}, saves, is_us}]
